question: Who among the following is the first Indian girl to win Jr. Squash Open in the US in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anahat Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anahat Singh** is the** first Indian girl to win Jr. Squash Open** in the** US in December 2021.**
 
• Indian teenager Anahat Singh made history by securing victory in the** U-15 girls category** of the esteemed Junior **US Open Squash tournament in Philadelphia.**
 
• The **13-year-old from Delhi **clinched the title by defeating Egypt's Jayda Marei in the final match with scores of 11-9, 11-5, 8-11, 11-5, held at the Arlen Specter Centre.
 
• This achievement is particularly noteworthy considering the tournament's scale, with over 850 squash junior players from 41 countries vying for victory in the world's largest individual junior squash tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sunayna Kuruvilla** is an Indian professional squash player who, as of February 2018, held the ranking of number 89 in the world.
 
• **Dipika Pallikal,** another Indian professional squash player, made history by becoming the first Indian to break into the top 10 in the PSA Women's rankings.
 
• **Akanksha Salunkhe** is an Indian professional squash player who, as of April 2022, held the ranking of number 99 in the world. She achieved success by winning the 2022 Guatemala Open.
